# DriftWatch

> DriftWatch watches a live LLM app for silent quality drift. It scores five signals (embedding drift, self-consistency, canary accuracy, judge trend, hallucination score), combines them into one score, and flags when that score crosses a threshold. It detects that quality moved, not always why.

## Pages
- [Home](/): what DriftWatch measures and how it works
- [Live demo](/demo): a shared demo dashboard you can push into drift with built-in scenarios
- [Privacy](/privacy): what data is stored and where

## Limits
- The hallucination score is a self-consistency heuristic, not fact checking.
- A quiet score means nothing obvious moved, not that nothing is wrong.
